name: Eunice (Timothy's mother)
title: Mother of Faith
summary: Eunice was a Jewish woman who came to faith in Christ and became the mother of Timothy, Paul's close coworker. She is known for her sincere faith which she passed on to her son, and together with her mother Lois, she laid the foundation for Timothy's knowledge of the Holy Scriptures from childhood.

keyEvents.title: Timothy's background mentioned
keyEvents.description: Paul meets Timothy in Lystra and notes that his mother was a believing Jew, while his father was a Greek.

keyEvents.title: The Sincere Faith
keyEvents.description: Paul reminds Timothy of the sincere faith that first lived in his grandmother Lois and his mother Eunice, and which now also lives in him.

keyEvents.title: Training in the Scriptures
keyEvents.description: Eunice and Lois taught Timothy the Holy Scriptures from childhood, laying the foundation for his ministry.
